quota_gate: TEAMLAB_DATABASE_QUOTA_BYTES compared with pg_database_size on connect
suite: 83 passed, 3 skipped; the three skips are tests/test_linux_execution.py without TEAMLAB_TEST_BROKER_SOCKET
note: Disposable loopback PostgreSQL 16 with a non-superuser owner role. The adapter sets 5 second statement and lock timeouts and can refuse connect when TEAMLAB_DATABASE_QUOTA_BYTES is below pg_database_size. This is not a PostgreSQL tablespace or disk quota and does not enforce the 256 MiB deployment policy by itself.
